content.title: Metiv's Research Unit
paragraphs: The research unit is responsible for applied and scientific knowledge, evaluating treatment programs and treatment methods, evaluating trainings for therapists, developing tools and collecting data to support decision-making.
In addition, the therapeutic work at Metiv is under ongoing monitoring and is examined using assessment tools in order to check and track clients' difficulties and progress.
content.focus: Treating post-traumatic stress in civilian and military target populations.
content.role: Bridging research knowledge and therapeutic practice in the field; translating insights into procedures and practices; supporting fundraising.
principles: Partnership with therapists and target communities
